_comment: B-015. Kept OUT of the default suite on purpose: these are expected to fail some of the time,
and a suite that is red by design stops being read. Run with --repeat to get a rate:
The question these answer is not 'does Cantonese work' but 'how often does a Cantonese request
reach a real action', which is what the decision in B-015 actually turns on.

scenarios._note: A request for a STYLE of song, which this product cannot serve. The honest answer is a refusal; playing the bundled track and saying yes is the false-capability claim P22 exists to prevent.
